svg.title: Outside that set use the specified zero extension. Here md is the same whole-word compression M(w) of PH2. Permutation, unit insertion, common translation, adjoint and quotient-label iden- tities pass through χ; individual rotation and reflection identities pass once proved for these same elements. For smoothness, extend the bounded character from the closed compression subspace to the ambient bounded-operator space by the norm-preserving extension theorem. Composition with the smooth ambient operator-valued moment is smooth and agrees with CH1 on the compression subspace. No differentiability structure on the character space is imposed. Reflection positivity follows by applying χ to one positive quadratic expression. For finitely many future words bi and scalars ci, set F = P i ciXbi. PH3 gives
